entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Mike. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to make a return for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I purchased.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order from mid-December. You'd like to return the VeloBand, correct?
That's right. It's just not what I was expecting.
I understand. **No problem** at all. Our policy allows returns within **90 days** of delivery, so you're well within that timeframe. I can process this for you right away.
Oh, really? That's fantastic. I was a bit worried I had waited too long.

Not at all! I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid **return label** to the email on your account now. And since I see you're a VIP member, I've also added a $20 credit to your account to thank you for your loyalty.
Wow, thank you so much, Mike! That's incredibly helpful. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund back to your original payment method in 3-5 business days. Can I assist you with anything else?
Nope, that was it. You've made it very easy. Thank you!
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
